channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Blanche Is Confirmed as Attorney General After Overcoming G.O.P. Concerns
item.description: Todd Blanche, who has served as acting attorney general since April, eked out Senate approval, despite growing unease about his willingness to rein in President Trump.

item.title: NPR: Federal funds can't be used to give test strips to drug users, raising overdose fears
item.description: Drug addiction groups are reeling after Trump officials said federal grants cannot be used to hand out test strips to drug users. The strips help users check street drugs for dangerous adulterants.

item.title: BBC News: Widdecombe police reopen investigation into incident at Farage's home, BBC understands
item.description: Counter-terror police investigating the ex-MP's death say they are looking into an "attempted burglary" last year.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘I’ve always felt too old and too young at the same time’: The Last of Us star Bella Ramsey on swapping child stardom for cult television – and Celebrity Traitors
item.description: At 22, Ramsey has already been on our screens for a decade, and nominated for every award going. So why do they find it strange to be called an actor? Bella Ramsey often feels more comfortable around older people. The ac…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Newcastle say they “didn’t want to sell” Guimaraes, as Arsenal move looms
item.description: Bruno Guimaraes looks set to move to Premier League champions Arsenal, but Newcastle say they did not want to sell.

item.title: Ars Technica: Europe's free satellite service just made it easier to track wildfires
item.description: Copernicus Browser adds wildfire visualization amid record wildfire season.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How Data Centers Broke American Politics
item.description: What the Unabomber, Steve Bannon’s tech guy, and Bernie Sanders taught me about the great data center backlash of 2026.

item.title: WIRED Science: Spokane Shows What the New Era of Wildfires Looks Like
item.description: With rising temperatures and drier conditions, fires are more likely to explode. And with more people living next to forests, the results can be catastrophic.

item.title: WIRED Business: The Chinese Philosopher Americans Can’t Stop Fighting About
item.description: Yiyang Zhuge was already an intellectual celebrity in China. Her viral interview with Christopher Nolan made her famous in the US—and quickly turned her into a political Rorschach test.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Senate’s Shameful Acquiescence to Todd Blanche as Attorney General
item.description: A number of Republicans resisted his confirmation, but enough ultimately accepted the notion that Trump could do even worse.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The Woman Having Sex on Her Building’s Roof
item.description: In this week’s story, a lesbian explores her complicated attraction to men.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The Vending Machines Replacing Subway Newsstands
item.description: Last seen underground in the 1970s, the snack dispensers are back with an update.

item.title: Fox59: DEA seizes 800 pounds of meth, making it the largest bust in Indiana history
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — The local DEA office has announced that authorities have made the largest meth seizure in Indiana history. A news release sent Friday said that DEA agents, along with ATF, Homeland Security and Indiana Sta…

item.title: Mirror Indy: We asked for Indy’s best mechanics. You sent us 14 recommendations.
item.description: Readers called these auto shops ‘trustworthy,’ ‘reasonable’ and ‘really nice.’ The post We asked for Indy’s best mechanics. You sent us 14 recommendations. appeared first on Mirror Indy .
